name: Bounded security review
description: Review one security surface through trust boundaries, abuse cases, static evidence, mitigations, and clearly stated residual risk.

outcomes.description: Validated findings are tied to reachable inputs, impact, mitigation, and severity rationale.
A receipt records trust boundaries, residual risk, and safe owner actions without sensitive proof.

prerequisites.description: The in-scope component, data flow, identities, and trust boundaries are named.
prerequisites.check: Draw the boundary in plain language before running checks.

prerequisites.description: The review can use source, fixtures, or an authorized safe environment without exploiting live accounts.
prerequisites.check: Confirm test data and owner boundary before collecting evidence.

lanes.objective: Map trust boundaries, inputs, identities, abuse cases, and intended mitigations.
Run bounded static and dependency checks and record findings without retaining sensitive proof.
Validate reachable findings, mitigation behavior, and residual risk in a safe environment.

qualityGates.description: Trust boundaries, assets, identities, and in-scope paths are explicit before findings are ranked.
Important findings are reproduced or reasoned from reachable code and have a mitigation disposition.
The receipt communicates risk without secret values, exploit payloads, or private evidence.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response during the security review.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; inspect only authorized safe evidence afterward.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Test live accounts, billing, account security, destructive data, or live financial execution.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Security review must not become unauthorized live exploitation.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Preserve the review scope and return to the last known-good mitigation state if validation is inconclusive or introduces risk.
rescueSteps: Capture finding classes and safe reproduction summaries.
Remove sensitive proof and keep mitigations separately reviewable.
Record residual risk and abandon an unvalidated claim.
stopConditions: A test would touch a live account or sensitive data.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Never include credentials, tokens, exploit payloads, private paths, or sensitive data.
Name finding classes and safe identifiers only.
